note: Independent source rejudgment. RFC 1997, Well-known Communities, NO_ADVERTISE: 'All routes received carrying a communities attribute containing this value MUST NOT be advertised to other BGP peers.' All 3 positive and 2 negative tagged covers were read. Q1: both internal and external announcements are forbidden, not withdrawals. Q2: internal/component/bgp/wireu/rfc1997_wellknown_test.go TestWellKnownNoAdvertiseRefusesEveryPeer checks false for both peer types; TestWellKnownNoAdvertiseAbsentAdvertisesToEveryPeer checks true for both with an ordinary community. internal/component/bgp/reactor/rfc1997_forward_wellknown_test.go TestForwardNoAdvertiseSkipsEveryPeer checks the announced-destination set, not all UPDATE delivery. test/plugin/wellknown-no-advertise-egress.ci requires 180A0100 withdrawn at BOTH destinations and rejects it only in announced fields (lines 46/52 and 60/65); the ordinary-community fence is positively announced on both sessions (50/63). A rule that leaks, loses withdrawals, or forwards nothing cannot satisfy this combination. Q3: the source supplies valid, separate well-known-community routes followed by a fence; distinct prefixes separate NO_ADVERTISE from NO_EXPORT_SUBCONFED. internal/test/fixture/plugin_fixture_16.go plugin16WellknownCounts quiesces and checks exact outgoing counts; counts are synchronization controls, not the normative assertion, which remains in peer field-scoped expectations/rejections. Q4: 'other BGP peers' is unqualified and both peer classes are covered; no confederation exception is invented. Producers: internal/component/bgp/wireu/wellknown.go ScanWellKnown/AllowsEgressTo and internal/component/bgp/reactor/reactor_api_forward.go suppression-to-withdrawal path with forward_build.go buildWithdrawalPayload. internal/test/peer/checker_update_fields.go separates legacy/MP announcement and withdrawal fields; checker_update_fields_test.go includes real inbound and linger negative-consumer regressions. No newly identified semantic gap within the historical capability scope. Source verdict only, not a claim that this worker executed or renewed runtime proof.
